subject: Next steps: Finexa security evidence & stakeholder map
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Claudia Jones <claudia.jones@finexa.com>, Michael Li <michael.li@finexa.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-15T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Recap + next steps from today's call

Hi Claudia / Michael —

Great speaking with you this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps:  

1) Decision criteria we heard:
- Performance: 95th pct token latency under 300ms for short prompts (<=128 tokens)
- Cost predictability: ability to reserve capacity / caps for production
- Security & compliance: SOC 2, pen test summary, audit logs, and data retention policy
- Data residency: US-only hosting for customer data

2) Stakeholder map (as discussed):
- Economic buyer: Claudia Jones, CFO (final sign-off for budget/PO)
- Security lead: Michael Li, Head of Security (technical vetting / evidence)
- Procurement: Sanjay Patel, Procurement Manager (SOW/PO and legal redlines)
- Engineering: (TBD) — will identify the primary integration lead after legal signoff

3) Next actions (proposed timeline):
- We (Redwood) to deliver SOC 2 summary + pen test high-level findings + sample audit logs by EOD 7/15 (internal docs) — ACTION: Ben
- Michael to confirm if SOC 2 full report or just summary is acceptable for initial review — ACTION: Michael (by 7/16)
- Sanjay to share procurement playbook / timelines and any required vendor forms — ACTION: Sanjay (by 7/20)
- Claudia to confirm budget window and PO cadence — ACTION: Claudia (by 7/22)

Attachments: I will upload a short SOC 2 summary and the pen test high-level notes to the Drive link below. If you prefer DocuSign or a secured file drop, let me know.

Thanks — I'll follow up with the files shortly.

Best,
Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | (415) 555-0142

>
> Dylan — can you pull a 30-day sample from our staging logs (redact user IDs) and highlight the retention TTLs and retention-config options we offer? Target EOD today so Ben can send to Finexa.

Thanks — pulled a 30-day redacted sample and attached as audit-logs-extract.csv. Also drafted the retention language:  
- Default retention: 90 days for request/response payload metadata; 365 days for system-level logs (can be shortened on request)
- Customer-managed longer retention is possible with Dedicated/Private deployments

Attachment stub: audit-logs-extract.csv

I will also add a short paragraph explaining what we redact and why (PII removal, hashed IDs, no raw customer payloads in shared samples).

—Dylan

From: Michael Li <michael.li@finexa.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Claudia Jones <claudia.jones@finexa.com>, Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@finexa.com>
Date: 2026-07-15T13:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap + next steps from today's call

Thanks, Ben. Helpful recap. Quick responses from Security side:  

1) SOC 2: high-level summary is fine for initial vetting, but we will require the full SOC 2 Type II report during procurement. Please include the date range and the auditor name in the summary.
2) Pen test: a high-level summary of findings + confirmation there are no critical severity items is required. If critical/high items exist, we will need remediation timelines.
3) Audit logs: the sample sounds good — please ensure timestamps are in UTC and that any sampled request IDs are one-way hashed.

We'll also need an indication of encryption-in-transit and encryption-at-rest (TLS 1.2+, AES-256) and a contact for security/ops questions. I am happy to start with the redacted artifacts you send.

Michael Li
Head of Security | Finexa
michael.li@finexa.com

From: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@finexa.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Claudia Jones <claudia.jones@finexa.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-16T11:24:00-07:00
Subject: Procurement intake and vendor forms

Ben / Claudia —

Appreciate the timely follow-up. Procurement asks:  
- Please share vendor W-9 and standard Master Services Agreement (or sample SOW)
- We have a one-week legal review SLA after receiving the draft MSA/SOW; procurement processing takes an additional 7-10 business days after legal signoff
- We use Ariba for PO routing; do you have an Ariba vendor ID or will we create one?

We will review the SOC 2 summary + pen test notes once received. For timelines: if we get all materials by 7/17, procurement and legal can likely complete review by end of July, with a PO issued early August assuming no major redlines.

Thanks — looking forward to the files.

Sanjay Patel
Procurement Manager | Finexa
sanjay.patel@finexa.com
